Rewarding day, bravo to the welfare team
It was a good run
Travel notes from the Companion Animal Travel Desk

Staff kept the focus on calm handling, clear guidance, and steady checks, which made today's animal journeys feel orderly and humane. Passengers appreciated the simple briefings before departure, and the safety coordinator kept a sharp eye on risks and prevention.

On the ground, <<FACT F009>> Handlers stayed patient with every carrier and crate, while the lounge team kept routines smooth and reassuring. <<FACT F001>> <<FACT F022>> The result was a more confident trip for animals and travelers alike, and that standard will remain our expectation.
